required_documents.title: Internal: Direct Deposit Delay Inquiries Protocol

rows.quote: When a customer contacts support asking where their direct deposit is or claiming it hasn't shown up yet, this is almost always because they are not aware of the correct timing for their incoming direct deposits.

kindly inform the customer about typical direct deposit timing (deposits usually post between 6 AM and 9 AM on the scheduled pay date, and some employers process payroll 1-2 business days before the official pay date while others process on the day itself)
Advise them to check back at the appropriate time and verify their pay schedule with their employer.
Direct deposits can take up to 3 days to arrive, depending on when your payer processes payroll and transmits the funds.
